substitutions_from_original_plan: W1.2 named UCF-Crime and ESC-50/UrbanSound8K explicitly. UCF-Crime and the CUHK Avenue dataset (the plan's own documented fallback) were both impractical here: UCF-Crime requires a gated multi-GB download, and the official Avenue mirror (cse.cuhk.edu.hk) served at ~40 KB/s in this environment (~5h for 813MB) against an 18GB free-disk budget. Substituted GitHub-hosted, directly downloadable, citable academic datasets covering the same event categories the schedule scenarios need (violence/fight, abandoned object) instead of blocking on a single slow mirror, per the plan's own 'never spend more than one day blocked on a single component' rule.

'scream' has no ESC-50 category; substituted 'siren' (present) as an additional hazard-style audio event. Glass-break and alarm categories are covered by real ESC-50 recordings rather than the previous synthetic glass_break.wav.
